name: Univocity
source: Max, a former engineer who turned fugitive, is headed to the top of tallest tower of Univocity—an urban sprawl owned by Ōṁ, a global tech monopoly—to set off an electromagnetic pulse bomb that will plunge the city into a technological dark age. But their plans are disrupted when they encounter Nina, an Ōṁ employee, which sparks a conversation that makes them question their motives.
translation: 麦克斯是一名前工程师，后来逃亡，他正前往Univocity（全球科技垄断企业Ōṁ拥有的城市扩张区）最高塔的顶部，引爆一枚电磁脉冲炸弹，使这座城市陷入技术黑暗时代。但当他们遇到 Ōṁ 员工尼娜时，他们的计划被打乱了，这引发了一场对话，让他们质疑自己的动机。
